member.name: T:Fuxion.Windows.Controls.UnhandledExceptionWindow
member.summary: Provides a window for displaying unhandled exceptions with options to close, restart, or send error reports.

remarks.para: This WPF window is designed to present unhandled exceptions to users in a user-friendly manner, offering various actions such as closing the application, restarting it, or sending an error report. It automatically formats exception details using for easy reading.

item.description: Exception display: Shows exception type and formatted details in a FlowDocument
Flexible actions: Configurable buttons for closing or restarting the application
Details toggle: Optional expandable section to show full exception details
Error reporting: Optional callback to send error reports to a server or logging service
Adaptive UI: Changes window style and size based on whether details are shown
Display global unhandled exceptions from Application.DispatcherUnhandledException
Show task exceptions from async operations
Provide user-friendly error dialogs with recovery options
Collect and send error reports for debugging
